name: Santa Teresa, the bohemian hilltop

map.note: Matches the map's hill pocket south-west of Centro: colourful houses with terracotta roofs, the yellow bonde on its track, the hill's trees. The map was not edited.

takes_over: the reading nook family (stickers 'reading'); filled by reading-list books finished
host: Caetano (friend-frog, shipped original art) reads on his cushion on a crate of atlases in the studio; he hosts the Journal, the reading list and the museum
notes: Outside and inside 384x240 (24x15 tiles), 16 px tiles, 3/4 top-down, light from the top-left. Hard alpha; day images use palette colours only (no new colours). All drawn new for Esme World: no real logos, no readable text, our own tile mosaic and our own Sugarloaf. The name only goes in the tooltip.

locations.name: The street, the bonde and the lookout

stages.rule: The base stage follows reading-list books finished: START from opening day (books fill shelf and cover slots, milestones add furniture; see inside-slots.json fill_rule), FULL once the studio is full (a suggestion: when every first-bookcase slot is filled; the app's call). Outside follows the same stage.
stages.start: a quiet studio: nearly empty shelves, a chair, one stack of books; outside a quiet street with the bonde at the stop
stages.full: shelves floor to ceiling with books piled on top, every milestone, friends reading and painting; outside the bonde packed, cafe tables full, people browsing

looks.rain: when Rio is rainy; add the streak overlay

characters: Esme, Mr Cat and Caetano are the shipped sprites (kept in their true colours at night). Everyone else is one of the ten Rio townsfolk (art/sources/rio-pack/townsfolk/folk.py) in their own faces.

reused.sult_props: bentwood chairs, street lamp, string of bulbs and umbrellas from art/sources/rio-pack/sult/sprops.py (imported)
